clap-wrapper 0.17.0 (https://github.com/free-audio/clap-wrapper, branch main,
commit 806bba0a5f792e3966b99c1561ab9952d3316d7c), cloned without its .git
directory, with patches/clap-wrapper/0001-vst3-midi-values-and-program-change-order.patch
applied (exact MIDI controller values and program change after bank select in
the VST3 wrapper - see the patch header).

To update: clone the new commit here, delete its .git, then
  git apply ../../patches/clap-wrapper/*.patch   (from external/clap-wrapper)

License: MIT (see LICENSE). Builds FluidSynthPlayer.vst3 from the same code
as the CLAP (see FSP_BUILD_VST3 in the top CMakeLists.txt).
